title: Ultra Rich Korean Trout Mandu
description: A fatty and molten Korean dish featuring trout, cooked in a tagine style and served in individual mini cocottes, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this sugar free friendly dish is a must try.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine chili flakes, soy sauce, sesame oil, green onions, garlic, and ginger to make the marinade.
Place the trout fillets in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them, making sure they are fully coated.
Let the trout marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Lay a mandu wrapper on a flat surface and place a marinated trout fillet in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal the mandu.
Place the mandu in individual mini cocottes and bake for 12 minutes.
Serve the mandu hot and enjoy.
